ss.title: Windows says “unknown publisher”?
ss.intro: Windows SmartScreen shows this the first time you run a downloaded app. It is normal. Four taps and it is gone:
ss.whenBody: Only the first time you run a file downloaded from the internet. Windows hasn't seen this file before, so it asks you to double-check. It is not a virus warning about AiBOX itself.
ss.step1: Click “More info” on the blue screen.
ss.step4: The installer opens. You are done.
ss.shaTitle: How to check the file is genuine
ss.shaBody: Every release file has a SHA-256 checksum on the GitHub Releases page. Compare it with the file you downloaded — if they differ, don't run the file. AiBOX also verifies every download automatically before installing.
ss.note: We are an unsigned portable app for now. Signing arrives when we can afford a certificate — never send your key to anyone.

gk.title: macOS says the app “can’t be opened”?
gk.intro: Gatekeeper shows this the first time you open an app downloaded from the internet. It is normal. Four steps and it is gone:
gk.whenBody: Only the first time you open an app downloaded from the internet. Apple hasn’t seen this app before, so it asks you to double-check. It is not a virus warning about AiBOX itself.
gk.step2: Click “Open” on the dialog (not “Move to Trash”).
gk.step3: Still blocked? Apple menu → System Settings → Privacy & Security → scroll down → “Open Anyway”.
gk.step4: Confirm with Touch ID or your password. AiBOX opens. You are done.
gk.note: This build is ad-hoc signed and not notarized yet — macOS warns on first open by design. Notarization arrives when we can afford it; never send your key to anyone.

err.title: Something went wrong
err.cancelled: You cancelled the install. Nothing was changed.
err.registry: Could not reach the app list. Check your network and retry.
err.scanFailed: Could not check your system. Retry, or export diagnostics.
err.netDead: All download sources timed out. Check your network, then retry.
err.hashMismatch: The downloaded file doesn't match its checksum — it may be tampered with. Try another source.
err.execFailed: The installer couldn't run or exited with an error. Export diagnostics, then retry.
err.probeFailed: Installed, but the version check didn't pass. Retry, or skip this component.
err.downloadFailed: The download didn't finish. Check your network, then retry.
err.generic: Something went wrong. Retry, or export diagnostics.

e1.title: Network trouble
